Ordering from ParMed Pharmaceuticals can now be done via the ParMed App. As a ParMed customer you can use the ParMed App to perform the following using your existing parmed.com website username and password:
 
- Search for products (including via Barcode Scanning!)
- View product details
- Create, checkout and submit your shopping cart
- View order status, order history, and details
 
The ParMed App is connected to parmed.com so you can create a shopping cart on parmed.com and then submit it from your mobile device, create the shopping cart on your mobile device and submit it on parmed.com or perform the entire ordering process via the ParMed App.
 
If you are not a current parmed.com user, please register on parmed.com to create your user account before using the ParMed App.

Baby Daybook is all in one baby tracker with family sync, child growth tracking, reminder notifications, baby development photo albums and more!
Our breastfeeding, diaper and sleep tracker is invaluable in monitoring your newborn's day.
Comprehensive baby activity statistics with sleeping recommendations is like a sleep consultant in your palm.

BABY ACTIVITY LOG

This newborn tracker offers all activity types as well as allows creating your own custom baby activities to track.

* Breastfeeding tracker
Start a nursing timer to track feeding duration for each breast.

* Baby sleeping tracker
Improve baby's sleeping quality by recording overnight sleeps and day naps.

* Bottle tracking
Log breast milk or formula feeding and quickly note the amount.

* Solids logging
Monitor newborn's reaction to solid feeding to find preferences or allergies.

* Pumping tracker
Log breast pumping sessions and see the daily amount and last used side at a glance.

* Diaper changes
Track how many diapers you change during a day and when was the last poop.

* Potty training
Simplify the challenge of getting rid of diapers.

* Child health tracking
Keep track of temperature measurements, medicine, symptoms, doctor visits and vaccinations of your baby.

* And more
Log baby bath, tummy time, walking outside, playtime and other activities to have a full picture of baby's day.

FEATURES

Our baby logger app comes with many useful features:

* Family sync
Share breastfeeding log and baby sleep patterns with caregivers in real-time.

* Daily summary
See time breastfeed per breast, total amount of breast milk, pump volume, or solid foods counts at a glance.

* Search and filter
Search your baby log to quickly find and filter your pump log, nursing log or other baby activities.

* Statistics
Monitor your newborn's sleep schedule, see naptime patterns and find baby feeding trends.

* Timeline
See a visual representation of your baby's day naps and night sleeps. Notice sleep patterns and get your baby on a regular schedule.

* Moments
Capture precious moments of your baby's first years and see the development of your little one.

* Growth charts
Record your child's weight, height and head circumference and compare them against world averages of CDC and WHO. See the adjusted growth chart for premature babies.

* Reminders
Maintain infant's routine by setting up reminders for upcoming activities. Never miss the next diaper change, nursing session, medication or doctor visit.

* Data export
Export your baby activity log to a printable file and share it with a pediatrician.

* Voice commands
Interact with our baby feeding and diaper tracker app using your voice via the Google Assistant! You can find all voice commands here: https://babydaybook.app/google-assistant

Try Baby Daybook and you will love this simple but powerful newborn baby tracker!
